title: The Underground river under the city
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：underground　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 underground 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the grower wrote of ① an underground river under the city in the ledger, and everybody in the greenhouse said at once that it was ② so underground that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it. Three summers on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grower, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the underground ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the underground river under the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for August 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too underground to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the underground ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the crate at the far shelf, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an underground movement of the city, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as underground as the movement of the city they had once had in the old greenhouse. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was underground or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something underground, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next greenhouse called the whole plan ⑧ quite underground; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the underground ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, in the rain, she wrote of another underground river under the city in the same ledger, and the work, which took two summers, seemed ⑨ no less underground than anybody had expected. ⑩ The underground movement of the city that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the underground ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 地下（前置定语 an underground river under the city：1991 年种植户在收成账里记下的那件地下的暗河）
B. adj. 地下／秘密（两处加强说法：so underground that … 与 no less underground than …）
C. adj. 地下／秘密（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 地下（表语 too underground to do：母亲觉得它太地下，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 秘密（前置定语 an underground movement of the city：叔叔把整件事称作一桩秘密的地下活动）
F. adj. 秘密（同级比较 as underground as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩城里的地下活动相比）
G. adj. 秘密（后置定语 something underground：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 秘密（受程度副词修饰 quite underground：那位收购人的评价）

items.q: an underground river under the city
the underground river under the city that
an underground movement of the city
The underground movement of the city that

answers.why: underground 意为“地下”，1991 年种植户在收成账里记下的是“一件地下的暗河”，此处作前置定语 an underground river under the city。
underground 意为“地下”，此处用 so underground that 结构，说它地下到大棚里没人敢靠近。
underground 意为“地下”，收成账上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的地下城下的暗河，等于最高级的说法。
underground 意为“地下”，母亲认为这件东西“太地下了，谁也用不上”，too underground to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
underground 意为“秘密”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩秘密的地下活动”，此处作前置定语 an underground movement of the city。
underground 意为“秘密”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩城里的地下活动一样秘密”，同级比较用 as underground as。
underground 意为“秘密”，收成账上那半行字要的是“秘密的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something underground。
underground 意为“秘密”，邻大棚来的那位收购人认为这套计划“相当秘密”，quite 修饰原级 underground。
underground 意为“秘密”，no less underground than 表示“其秘密不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之秘密不亚于任何人的预料。
underground 意为“秘密”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的秘密地下活动”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，种植户在收成账里记下了一件地下的暗河。（an underground river under the city）
它地下到大棚里没有一个人敢靠近。（so underground that …）
母亲觉得它太地下，谁也用不上。（too underground to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩秘密的地下活动。（an underground movement of the city）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩城里的地下活动一样秘密。（as underground as …）
到了 1998 年，收成账上只剩半行字：要的是一件秘密的东西。（something underground）
answers: In 1991 the grower wrote of an underground river under the city in the ledger.
It was so underground that nobody in the greenhouse would go near it.
My mother thought it too underground to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an underground movement of the city.
He said nobody would call it as underground as the movement of the city they had once had.
By 1998 the ledger asked for nothing but something underground.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 underground 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the grower wrote of an underground river under the city in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the underground river under the city that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too underground to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an underground movement of the city, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next greenhouse called the plan quite underground, and everybody laughed.
The underground ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
